nodes.declaration: export type AnswerLog = typeof answerLogs.$inferSelect

answerLogs = sqliteTable('answer_logs', {
  id: text('id').primaryKey(),
  userId: text('user_id').notNull(),
  questionId: text('question_id').notNull(),
  isCorrect: integer('is_correct', { mode: 'boolean' }).notNull(),
  answeredAt: integer('answered_at', { mode: 'timestamp_ms' }).notNull(),
  responseTimeMs: integer('response_time_ms'),
})
export type LessonView = typeof lessonViews.$inferSelect
export type QuestionRow = typeof questions.$inferSelect
export type SrsState = typeof srsStates.$inferSelect
export type User = typeof users.$inferSelect
export type AnalyticsHeatmapDay = z.infer<typeof analyticsHeatmapDaySchema>
export type AnalyticsHeatmapResponse = z.infer<typeof analyticsHeatmapResponseSchema>
export type AnalyticsRequest = z.infer<typeof analyticsRequestSchema>
analyticsRequestSchema = z.object({}).strict()
export type AnalyticsSummaryResponse = z.infer<typeof analyticsSummaryResponseSchema>

analyticsSummaryResponseSchema = z.object({
  totalAnswerCount: z.number().int().nonnegative(),
  correctAnswerRate: z.number().int().min(0).max(100),
  averageResponseTimeMs: z.number().int().nonnegative(),
  masteredQuestionCount: z.number().int().nonnegative(),
  currentStreakDays: z.number().int().nonnegative(),
  thisWeekStudyTimeMs: z.number().int().nonnegative(),
  retentionDistribution: retentionDistributionSchema,
})

analyticsWeeklyDateSchema = z
  .string()
  .regex(isoCalendarDatePattern)
  .refine(isValidCalendarDate, { message: 'date must be a valid calendar date' })
export type AnalyticsWeeklyDay = z.infer<typeof analyticsWeeklyDaySchema>
export type AnalyticsWeeklyResponse = z.infer<typeof analyticsWeeklyResponseSchema>
export type AnswerRequest = z.infer<typeof answerRequestSchema>
export type AnswerResponse = z.infer<typeof answerResponseSchema>
export type DomainsRequest = z.infer<typeof domainsRequestSchema>
domainsRequestSchema = z.object({}).strict()
export type DomainsResponse = z.infer<typeof domainsResponseSchema>
export type DomainSummary = z.infer<typeof domainSummarySchema>

domainSummarySchema = z.object({
  domain: domainKeySchema,
  masteredQuestionCount: z.number().int().nonnegative(),
  totalQuestionCount: z.number().int().nonnegative(),
  masteryRate: z.number().int().min(0).max(100),
  topicCount: z.number().int().nonnegative(),
  lessonCount: z.number().int().nonnegative(),
})
export type DueCountResponse = z.infer<typeof dueCountResponseSchema>
isoCalendarDatePattern = /^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/
export type LessonViewRequest = z.infer<typeof lessonViewRequestSchema>
export type LessonViewResponse = z.infer<typeof lessonViewResponseSchema>
export type MistakeItem = z.infer<typeof mistakeItemSchema>
export type MistakesResponse = z.infer<typeof mistakesResponseSchema>
export type RateLimitedErrorResponse = z.infer<typeof rateLimitedErrorResponseSchema>

export type RateLimitUnavailableErrorResponse = z.infer<
  typeof rateLimitUnavailableErrorResponseSchema
>
export type RecentActivityAnswerRecorded = z.infer<typeof recentActivityAnswerRecordedSchema>

recentActivityAnswerRecordedSchema = recentActivityBaseSchema
  .extend({
    type: z.literal('answer_recorded'),
    questionId: z.string().min(1),
    lessonId: z.string().min(1).nullable(),
    isCorrect: z.boolean(),
  })
  .strict()
export type RecentActivityItem = z.infer<typeof recentActivityItemSchema>

recentActivityItemSchema = z.discriminatedUnion('type', [
  recentActivityLessonViewedSchema,
  recentActivityAnswerRecordedSchema,
])
export type RecentActivityLessonViewed = z.infer<typeof recentActivityLessonViewedSchema>
export type RecentActivityResponse = z.infer<typeof recentActivityResponseSchema>
export type RetentionDistribution = z.infer<typeof retentionDistributionSchema>
export type ReviewQueueResponse = z.infer<typeof reviewQueueResponseSchema>
export type DomainKey = z.infer<typeof domainKeySchema>
domainKeySchema = z.enum(['security', 'frontend', 'backend', 'architecture'])
export type LessonFrontmatter = z.infer<typeof lessonFrontmatterSchema>

lessonFrontmatterSchema = z.object({
  domain: domainKeySchema,
  topic: z.string().min(1),
  lessonId: lessonIdSchema,
  title: z.string().min(1),
  estimatedMinutes: z.number().int().positive(),
  questions: z.array(questionSchema).min(1),
})

lessonIdSchema = z
  .string()
  .regex(/^[a-z0-9-]+$/, 'lessonId must contain only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens')
export type McqQuestion = z.infer<typeof mcqQuestionSchema>

mcqQuestionSchema = z.object({
  id: questionIdSchema,
  type: z.literal('mcq'),
  prompt: z.string().min(1),
  choices: z.array(z.string().min(1)).min(2).max(6),
  answerIndex: z.number().int().nonnegative(),
  explanation: z.string().min(1),
})
export type Question = z.infer<typeof questionSchema>

questionIdSchema = z
  .string()
  .regex(/^[a-z0-9-]+$/, 'questionId must contain only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens')
questionSchema = z.discriminatedUnion('type', [mcqQuestionSchema])
export type TopicFrontmatter = z.infer<typeof topicFrontmatterSchema>
INITIAL_EASE = 2500
MIN_EASE = 1300

export type SrsResult = {
  ease: number
  intervalDays: number
  reps: number
  lapses: number
  dueAt: number
}
